Math Fact Drill Sheet Generator

Every "Generate" will now rebuild the identical sheet above. Export settings to save the seed for a make-up test or next year.

For self-checking stations — prints a compact answer key box on the worksheet itself instead of making students hunt for a separate page.

Generates that many randomized sheets (Version A/B/C…) back to back — useful for preventing copying during a timed drill.

Instead of different random problems per version, every version above gets the exact same problem/answer set — just shuffled into a different order and renumbered. A neighbor's "#1" is a different problem, but the whole room is graded on the same set.

Builds three matching sheets from this template in one pass — same problem count and layout, with the operand range scaled down for Easy and up for Hard — so you can hand out the right level to each student without reconfiguring anything.
